providerEvidenceCopy: An owned cold txlog/checkpoint copy is allowed after actual provider closure with byte-exact original/copy pins before controlled mutation. Distinguish original provider directory and oracle input copy. Copy no tokens or credentials; preserve controlled negative bytes and failed fixtures. Do not restore original histories.

applicationCondition: Root reviews closed test/helper bodies first, applies those two paths, runs actual missing-oracle RED, then reviews and applies independent source. Recheck exact D15 and current pins before each R write.
